articles.title: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals Stock Soars as Drug-Price Cut Boosts Prospects for 2026
articles.mainIdea: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals Stock Soars as Drug-Price Cut Boosts Prospects for 2026
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Ironwood Pharmaceuticals Stock Soars as Drug-Price Cut Boosts Prospects for 2026. The company said it expects total revenue of between $450 million and $475 million this year, up from the $290 million to $310 million it had told investors to expect for 2025. Related tickers mentioned: IRWD.
